name: serp-api
label: SerpApi
description: Get search results from Google, Google News, YouTube and Google Trends.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: You can obtain your API key from [Dashboard](https://serpapi.com/dashboard).

google_search.label: Google Search
google_search.description: Search Google and get the results as seen from a place and language.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: What to search for on Google.

location_search.label: Find Location
location_search.description: Type a city or region, then pick the match in Location.

location.label: Location
location.description: Results as seen from this place.

google_domain.label: Google Domain
google_domain.description: Which Google site to search, such as google.co.uk.

num_results.label: Number of Results
num_results.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 100.

start.label: Results to Skip
start.description: Skip this many results to get later pages.

filter.label: Similar Results
filter.description: Hide results Google treats as near duplicates.

device.label: Device
device.description: Get the results a desktop, phone or tablet would see.

no_cache.label: Cached Results
no_cache.description: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.

async.label: Search Mode
async.description: The ID-only option gives no results and needs cached results allowed.

google_search.afterResponse:
if (response && response.error) return { success: false, error: String(response.error), error_type: 'Error', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), search_query: inputs.query };
return { success: true, data: response };

google_news_search.description: Search Google News for recent articles about a topic or brand.

query.label: Search Query

no_cache.label: Cached Results
no_cache.description: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.

async.label: Search Mode

output.label: Response Format

google_news_search.afterResponse:

google_trends_search.label: Google Trends Search
google_trends_search.description: See how interest in a search term changes over time and by region.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Up to 5 terms, comma-separated, for Interest Over Time or Compare Terms by Region.

geo.label: Region
geo.description: Region whose search interest is measured.

data_type.label: Data Type
data_type.description: What to measure about the search term.

category.label: Category
category.description: Category ID from SerpApi's Google Trends list; 0 means all.

property_filter.label: Search Source
property_filter.description: Which Google search the interest comes from.

no_cache.label: Cached Results
no_cache.description: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.

async.label: Search Mode
async.description: The ID-only option gives no results and needs cached results allowed.

output.label: Response Format
output.description: JSON gives structured data; HTML is the raw results page.

google_trends_search.afterResponse:
if (response && response.error) return { success: false, error: String(response.error), error_type: 'Error', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), search_query: inputs.query };
return { success: true, data: response };

search_google_web_ai.label: Google Search (Agent)
search_google_web_ai.description: Run a Google web search and return organic results for a query.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: The web search query to execute, e.g. "best electric cars 2024".

location.label: Location
location.description: Free-text geographic location to originate the search from, e.g. "Austin, Texas, United States". SerpApi resolves it server-side. Optional.

hl.label: Language (hl)
hl.description: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.

gl.label: Country (gl)
gl.description: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Optional.

device.label: Device
device.description: Device to simulate: one of "desktop", "mobile", or "tablet". Optional.

num_results.label: Number of Results
num_results.description: Number of results to return (1-100). Optional.

search_google_web_ai.afterResponse:
if (response && response.error) return { success: false, error: String(response.error), error_type: 'Error', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), search_query: inputs.query };
return { success: true, data: response };

search_google_trends_ai.label: Google Trends Search (Agent)
search_google_trends_ai.description: Query Google Trends for interest in a keyword over time and across regions.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: The keyword or topic to analyze trends for, e.g. "artificial intelligence".

data_type.label: Data Type
data_type.description: Type of trends data: one of "TIMESERIES" (interest over time, default), "GEO_MAP" (interest by region), "RELATED_TOPICS", or "RELATED_QUERIES". Optional.

geo.label: Geographic Location
geo.description: Uppercase two-letter region code to scope the trend to, e.g. "US", "GB", "JP". Leave empty for worldwide. Optional.

date.label: Time Period
date.description: Trends date range token, e.g. "today 12-m" (past 12 months), "today 5-y", "now 7-d", or "all". Optional.

category.label: Category
category.description: Google Trends category id (0 for all categories). Optional.

gprop.label: Property Filter
gprop.description: Google property to filter by: empty for web, or "images", "news", "froogle" (shopping), "youtube". Optional.

hl.label: Language (hl)
hl.description: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.

search_google_trends_ai.afterResponse:
if (response && response.error) return { success: false, error: String(response.error), error_type: 'Error', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), search_query: inputs.query };
return { success: true, data: response };

search_google_maps.label: Search Google Maps
search_google_maps.description: Find local businesses and places on Google Maps for a query.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: What to search for, e.g. "coffee shops" or "Pizza Hut".

ll.label: Map Center (ll)
ll.description: GPS coordinates of the map center as "@latitude,longitude,zoom", e.g. "@40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z". Required once you paginate with Start. Optional otherwise.

start.label: Start Position
start.description: Zero-based offset for pagination (multiples of 20). Requires Map Center (ll). Optional.

hl.label: Language (hl)
hl.description: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.

gl.label: Country (gl)
gl.description: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.

search_google_maps.afterResponse:
if (response && response.error) return { success: false, error: String(response.error), error_type: 'Error', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), search_query: inputs.query };
return { success: true, data: response };
